question: According to the Sustainable Development Report, 2025, what is India's rank on the SDG Index and what is its approximate score?
solution:
The correct answer is __**99th with score ≈66.95**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to the **Sustainable Development Report 2025**, India has secured the **99th** rank globally. This ranking reflects the country's cumulative progress toward the **17 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)** established by the **United Nations**.
 
• India’s overall index score is approximately **66.95**. This score is a measure of the total progress towards achieving all **17 SDGs**, where a score of **100** indicates that all targets have been fully met.
 
• The **Sustainable Development Report (SDR)** is an annual global assessment published by the **Sustainable Development Solutions Network (SDSN)**. It provides a comprehensive report card on the progress of **UN Member States**.
 
• India has shown notable improvements in several areas, particularly in **Goal 1 (No Poverty)** and **Goal 12 (Responsible Consumption and Production)**. These advancements contribute to the overall score of **66.95**.
